## Summary and General Analysis
- Guinaifen has a chance to apply "Firekiss" to any enemies taking damage from Burn. Enemies with "Firekiss" have increased Vulnerability.
- Using her Ultimate on enemies inflicted with Burn will detonate any existing Fire DoT applied

## Noteable Investments
 ### E1, E4, E6
- E1 increases the chance for allies to apply debuffs.
- E4 makes her gain extra Energy whenever enemies take damage from Burn applied by Guinaifen.
- E6 increases the amount of "Firekiss" stacks she can apply by 1, increasing the potency of her debuffs.

## Ability Rotation
- Basic ATK spam, Skill if needed
